binding_requirements.rule: An accepted future proof MUST bind every semantically required fact directly or through one authenticated, historically resolvable derivation chain. Fields below are requirements, not invented DTO fields.

requirements.proof_identity: REQUIRED / claim fingerprint is content identity only
requirements.proof_generation_revision: CONDITIONAL; M0.3 bootstrap values exist but AccountGenesis meaning NOT_FROZEN
requirements.candidate_account_id_or_reservation_iden: REQUIRED before commit / binding mechanism NOT_FROZEN
requirements.logical_operation_or_equivalent: REQUIRED for retry convergence / identity NOT_FOUND
requirements.canonical_request_semantics_fingerprint: REQUIRED unless selected authenticated equivalent completely binds semantics / NOT_FOUND
requirements.issued_accepted_time: CONDITIONAL / M0.3 issued time exists, acceptance time absent

options.B_direct_exact_account_id: SELECTED: independent issuer proof exact binding

account_binding.mismatch_rule: Proof account_id MUST exactly equal INITIAL_BINDING account_id; mismatch REJECT.

operation_binding.changed_semantics_rule: different operation, account, request fingerprint, or INITIAL_BINDING tuple is REJECT

environment_binding.requirement: TEST root proof MUST NOT authorize PRODUCTION AccountGenesis
environment_binding.current_candidate: NOT_AVAILABLE; provisioning_context_fingerprint_sha256 is opaque and has no frozen environment/trust-domain semantics

authentication.current_source: NOMINAL accepted membership authority through ProvisioningBoundary abstract port
authentication.local_AccountGenesis_HMAC_role: may authenticate stored receipt bytes only; cannot establish external proof genuineness

freshness.issued_expiry: FirstRunBootstrapAuthority enforces issued_at_utc <= now_utc <= expires_at_utc for bootstrap consumption

validation_semantics.valid_root_proof_means: Prerequisite evidence from the frozen independent issuer contract, exact-bound to authoritative INITIAL_BINDING account, operation, request and entitlement.
does_not_prove: business subject may own exactly one account
validation owner owns final genesis decision

validation_output.semantic_role: durable subordinate CHA record that exact validation succeeded for one INITIAL_BINDING and is ACCEPTED_FOR_PREPARED_ONLY
validation_output.claimant_binding_model: AUTHORITATIVE_INDIRECT via exact entitlement id/generation and BOUND history; evidence retains claimant principal/key binding
validation_output.persistence: atomically stored with PREPARED under dedicated AccountGenesis local authority integrity/custody boundary; partial PREPARED impossible
validation_output.winning_attempt_rule: must reference exact actual issuer BOUND winner, its requester/claimant key versions, authoritative BOUND history and exact proof; never newest-local preference

winning_attempt_digest_semantics.consistency: winning attempt ID + immutable identity digest + authoritative BOUND history + exact root proof MUST mutually match

winning_attempt_end_to_end_consistency.local_attempt_id: MUST equal admission and issuer history ID
winning_attempt_end_to_end_consistency.immutable_digest: MUST resolve the local immutable identity payload for that exact ID
winning_attempt_end_to_end_consistency.signed_request_identity: MUST exactly match issuer-retained signed RootProofIssuanceRequest identity; semantic equivalence is insufficient

consumption_semantics.entitlement_transition: issuer-owned globally serialized UNBOUND -> BOUND(exact tuple, proof identity, signing key version)

replay.one_external_R_validated_twice: ONLY exact same tuple retry; idempotent same proof and same terminal operation
replay.same_proof_same_logical_operation_retry: IDEMPOTENT_SAME_PROOF; MUST NOT create a second account

historical_provenance.requirement: Every future committed genesis MUST immutably identify and resolve the exact accepted root proof, issuer/authority domain, authenticated derivation/validation evidence, bindings and commit-time validity decision without current-state substitution.

restart.requirement: Recover the exact accepted proof/receipt/provenance and same logical decision/result, or fail closed.

rollback.requirement: Rollback of accepted proof/receipt/history MUST be detected by future AccountGenesis freshness closure or recovery MUST fail closed.

authority_boundary.non_circular_rule: Root for acct_A MUST be independent of acct_A and every child/account-scoped authority whose legitimacy requires acct_A.

failure_semantics.public_literals: NOT_FROZEN; do not invent API error literals
failure_semantics.policy: Every unverifiable critical proof state is DENY / FAIL_CLOSED; never fallback to local self-authorization.

classes.proof stale: DENY / FAIL_CLOSED; exact public literal NOT_FROZEN
classes.account binding mismatch: DENY / FAIL_CLOSED when binding exists; missing required binding blocks admission
classes.operation binding mismatch: DENY / FAIL_CLOSED when operation-bound model exists; otherwise contract DESIGN_BLOCKED
classes.proof already consumed: DENY only if future single-use model selected; otherwise NOT_FROZEN
